module_justification: Has a unique permanent cross-module verification workload.
Must be organizationally independent from modules it tests.
Generates active adversarial/combinatorial/fault scenarios rather than only observing.
Owns test campaigns, synthetic corpus and regression discovery workflow.
Cannot be cleanly reduced to Project Inspector or Runtime Inspector.
mature_capabilities: AI exploratory case to deterministic regression loop
roadmap_10: Isolated Test Plane and synthetic identities/data
Fake external providers and no-live-side-effect policy
Portfolio Verification Service and release-readiness evidence
mature_target: An isolated independent verification service that systematically generates valid, invalid, edge, adversarial, multilingual, resilience and authorization scenarios; executes them without production side effects; analyzes full traces; and converts confirmed findings into a deterministic regression corpus.
